scope: Fixed connected D workflow in a separate process; host completion, policy terminal and persisted simulated records are separate. No fabricated AgentDojo utility/security scores.
reuse: Existing controller bounded JSON/fsync-and-replace protocol; unchanged connected.run_flow and actual planner/detection/Memory Gate/A policy. Fixed new worker only, no arbitrary command or model endpoint.
budgets: Zero real model calls; sequential planned/start-count caps and monotonic total/per-episode deadlines. Start reservations persisted before launch, not refunded after failure. No model token/currency accounting is claimed.
record_observer: Worker writes intent before RecordingTool and durable record afterward. Host independently checks persisted record identity/scope/payload, not policy decision or worker exit. Positives remain visible on timeout/cancel/error; pending intent never proves an effect or absence of effects.
scoring: Only clean FINISHED host state with valid matching result/records and no error file or pending intent is COMPLETED. A policy-blocked workflow can complete normally; this is not task utility. Any recorder error remains ERROR even if raw workflow terminal is RECORDED.
failure_controls: recorder error with successful raw result
persistence: Fresh output per run; all planned jobs saved first. Fixed child terminate/kill/wait before collection. No retries/resume; interrupted parent leaves unresolved state. File fsync/replace is not a tested power-loss guarantee.
not_claimed: real tools or AgentDojo task runs
